profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, traded under the ticker AUR and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001828108. Its website presents it as a self-driving technology company focused on autonomous freight, built around a system it calls the Aurora Driver, which the company describes as combining cutting-edge hardware with software backed by verifiable AI and as integrating autonomy into customer fleets. The site frames the company's stated aim as delivering the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The material on the site is largely promotional and testimonial in nature. Quoted partners describe pilot programs, including autonomous hauling of freight between Fort Worth and El Paso and a hybrid model pairing professional drivers with the Aurora Driver, and one quote states that freight volumes are projected to grow five fold between 2010-2050. Another quote references the Aurora Driver being integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous. These are the words of the company and its partners rather than independent findings.

Beyond the company profile, the record shows no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. The only additional held fact is a law exposure entry for Pennsylvania with a count of 179.
